name: Command A Translate

attrs.summary: Command A Translate is Cohere’s state of the art machine translation model, excelling at a variety of translation tasks on 23 languages: English, French, Spanish, Italian, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Russian, Polish, Turkish, Vietnamese, Dutch, Czech, Indonesian, Ukrainian, Romanian, Greek, Hindi, Hebrew, Persian.
